papers.title: Rooted Completion Certificates
papers.current_ceiling: The bounded rooted-completion results are retained; exact D4(C5^3)=30 is a proof target, not yet an authorized journal claim.
post_matrix_updates: The proof-producing D4 search design is now on main, but execution/claim authority remains separate from design completeness.
load_bearing_adverse: The prior CRB replay failed census receipt serialization and left D2/D3 authority CANNOT_CHECK.
SUBMISSION_BLOCKER records live_authorization ABSENT and d4_rounds_consumed 0.
A user-supplied attestation is not machine-established external or journal authority.
papers.strongest_remaining_gap: The exact D4(C5^3)=30 handoff needs an authorized one-shot execution, two genuinely independent encodings and a compact proof decomposition that a referee can replay without trusting the search implementation.
papers.decisive_question: Under a valid one-shot authorization, do independent exact encodings both certify D4(C5^3)=30 and emit checkable lower- and upper-bound proof objects?
papers.maximum_claim_if_supported: An exact, proof-producing determination of D4(C5^3)=30 with independently replayable certificates and a human-readable structural decomposition.
papers.hypothesis_or_theorem: Prove an explicit construction of size 30 and an independently checkable impossibility certificate for size 31, with agreement between non-isomorphic search encodings.
papers.population_or_universe: The full finite C5^3 completion universe under the frozen rooted-certificate definitions.
papers.unit_of_analysis: A candidate family for the upper bound or a proof node/certificate clause for the lower bound.
design: Keep design, authorization, execution and publication authority in separate records.
Use encoding A for candidate generation and encoding B for independent certificate replay.
Emit proof objects for both the size-30 construction and size-31 impossibility.
Write a decomposition lemma explaining the obstruction classes rather than presenting only a solver terminal.
Run hostile mutations of the construction, group action and certificate clauses.
baselines: A second exact encoding with different symmetry breaking and data structures.
Direct brute-force checks on all smaller boundary cases.
primary_endpoints: Proof size, replay time and symmetry-reduction audit.
negative_controls: Delete one certificate element from the size-30 construction.
Perturb a group action or orbit representative.
Drop one lower-bound clause and require the checker to reject the certificate.
Replay with authorization absent, which must not emit a scientific terminal.
analysis_plan: Exact decision only; no stochastic inference.
Record every solver/version/resource bound and timeout terminal.
Novelty subtraction covers Davenport/completion-number literature and any prior C5^3 computation.
papers.power_or_exhaustion_rule: Exhaust the frozen finite universe or validate a complete unsatisfiability certificate; timeout is CANNOT_CHECK, never evidence for the lower bound.
papers.success_gate: Both independent encodings agree, proof objects replay in a small trusted checker, the construction and lower-bound decomposition survive hostile mutation, and valid authorization binds the exact run.
papers.refutation_gate: A size-31 witness or invalid size-30 construction refutes the theorem; encoding disagreement blocks promotion and becomes a diagnostic result.
papers.cannot_check_gate: CANNOT_CHECK if one-shot authorization is absent/ambiguous, a proof object is missing, a solver times out or the two encodings disagree.
papers.authority_required: Valid operator authorization for the one-shot run, a deterministic proof checker independent of both encodings and independent primary-source theorem review.

active_lane.collision_rule: Do not spend the one-shot or fork a competing encoding until the authority record is machine-verifiable.

immediate_safe_actions: Complete the proof-decomposition outline and checker interface without accessing outcomes.
Audit the one-shot authorization schema for machine-verifiable presence and scope.
Run lower-dimensional controls that do not consume D4 authority.
forbidden_actions: Do not infer D4 from a timeout or solver log.
Do not rerun consumed D2/D3 identities as a rescue.
papers.journal_bar: A top-tier exact-computation paper needs proof objects, independent encodings, structural explanation, authorization custody and primary-source novelty closure.
papers.sibling_boundary: Owns the exact rooted-completion theorem; generic certificate realization belongs to ORION-01.
